headline: Fronts Stir Again Across Divided Sectors
war_summary: The latest returns show renewed movement along several divided fronts, with Weathered Expanse still the war’s chief furnace. It logged 56 base events in 24 hours, including seven in the latest two-hour window, while the ledger stands at four Warden holdings, two Colonial, and three neutral; casualty rates remain heavy despite cooling on the two-hour comparison. Palantine Berm has sharply quickened, recording 48 daily events and nine in the latest two hours, with five Warden bases, one Colonial, and one neutral. Callahan’s Passage also remains active at 39 daily events and three recently, though all ten strategic bases presently belong to the Wardens. Stlican Shelf records 25 daily events, two recent, and remains divided at seven Colonial, one Warden, and one neutral holding. Stonecradle has eight daily events, three recent, with eight Colonial bases and one Warden. Nevish Line is quiet in the latest window, but its 12-event daily record and seven-to-one Warden advantage keep it worth watching. Elsewhere, most sectors report no base movement.
